in_marathi.name: Vengatesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vengatesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vengatesh is derived from the Tamil language and is a combination of two words - Ven (Lord) and Gatesh (Victory). This name is believed to represent the lord of victory who bestows power, protection, and success upon his devotees.

in_bengali.name: Vengatesh

This name is believed to represent the lord of victory who bestows power, protection, and success upon his devotees.
